summary: DeFi Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated November 4, 2026, announcing a shareholder call on Friday, November 13, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. EST to discuss third-quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, with financial statements to be released after market close on November 12, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. The filing is a routine earnings-call logistics notice, mapping to a US issuer's 8-K/earnings announcement; no risk-arb angle applies.
